facts.fact: 兄弟信差：Keegan 几十年认清父亲、Gideon 只有几周—— façade 下仍希望 Rendel 是另一种父亲；声音喂的正是这份希望。
facts.anchor: Keegan had had decades to learn who his father was, but Gideon had only had weeks

facts.fact: 老妇的魔法观：听见召唤不必回应——克制是根基；Maeve 的印亮了一下。
双印判词升级：两印不该落在同一人身上——Stonewick 与 Shadowick 曾以几乎无人记得的协议相连，石头守护「残存之物」。
facts.anchor: Those marks were never meant to be placed on one person.

facts.fact: 通道会「认东西」：印之后还想认别的；Gideon 越过众人去够刻纹被 Keegan 扣腕——怒目几乎认不出。
facts.anchor: I’m saying you should leave before the passage recognizes anything else.

facts.fact: 牵引有选择性（for some）——Gidian 从不肯被说服的人变成视线钉死石阶的人。
facts.anchor: The pull is too much for some

facts.fact: 声音的私密饵料：你知道我为什么不得不离开——正中 Gidian 最想填的空白；「face drained of color」。
facts.anchor: You know what happened. You know why I had to leave.

facts.fact: 独家情报钓饵：Stone Ward 未毁——与 hunch 完全对上；连读者都被钓。
facts.anchor: He said he knows where the Stone Ward is.

facts.fact: 地底之物定位：懂得让人倾听、有用途、有用——但「now is not that time」（老妇的时间表）。
facts.anchor: Something that knows how to make people listen.

facts.fact: 钓鱼闭环：信息必须下去拿；「The pull is too much for some」再补一刀。
facts.anchor: Rendel is trapped. He can’t leave.

facts.fact: 老妇一杖破催眠：淡光荡过、金纹黯淡、Gideon 如从噩梦中被唤醒——她与地底之物同级。
facts.anchor: Gideon stumbled backward as though he’d been awakened from a particularly unpleasant dream.

facts.fact: 惨剧触发器：Maeve 按住双印→双印同亮→Rendel 声音回来→Gideon 冲下石阶——她的安抚动作正是钥匙。
地面瞬间吞掉石阶：Keegan 跪地刨叶找不到任何痕迹——单向门连门都消失了。
facts.anchor: The ground instantly swallowed the stairs

facts.fact: 力量规则：双印=钥匙，但控制不了谁走进去——能力与责任脱钩。
facts.anchor: Your marks are the key, although that doesn’t mean you have any control over who walks through.

facts.fact: 通道重开≠重达：边界形成时与现在完全不同——「magical underground maze」。
facts.anchor: doesn’t mean it leads to the same place twice

facts.fact: 绑腕之约：缎带贴肤隐没，骗她时她会知道——「撒谎怎么办」「你们得自己琢磨」。
Caleb 见老妇血色褪尽：你不该在这里、你不是真的——「How did Caleb know who she was?」
名号揭幕：Caleb「我们把 Hedge Witch 亲自送到了她面前」——送到「女祭司都惧怕的那个人」面前。
facts.anchor: To the one the Priestess was afraid of.
